Title: The Magicians (The Magicians, #1)
Author: Lev Grossman
My Review: I nearly DNF's this one, which is a pity because I thought I would love it.  It really comes down to one big problem, the lead character, Q, is insufferable.  And we are in his head the whole time.  The book actually improves when the other characters are around.  I watched the TV series after, and it's more enjoyable.  But a lot of that comes from the increased time we spend with the other characters.
